messages:
Nisha (AE): BlueHarbor wants a short POC to validate SSO + SCIM + RBAC for multiple brand domains. Key asks: encrypted RelayState, group-to-role scoping, and domain-level allowlists.
Carlos (SE): Clarify RelayState requirement: do they need AES-encrypted RelayState on SP side or signed-only? Also: are they doing JIT user creation or bulk sync first?
Nisha (AE): They want RelayState encrypted for SSO redirect (security team requirement). They'll start with bulk import of existing users then keep delta sync.
Carlos (SE): We support SAML 2.0, both IdP-initiated and SP-initiated flows, and can optionally encrypt the RelayState token. NameID formats we support: persistent, transient, email. We also support SLO endpoints.
Carlos (SE): Short SAML metadata snippet to share with their IdP team:
```
<EntityDescriptor entityID="https://redwood.example/sp">
  <SPSSODescriptor protocolSupportEnumeration="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:protocol">
    <AssertionConsumerService Binding="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:bindings:HTTP-POST" Location="https://redwood.example/saml/acs" index="1"/>
    <SingleLogoutService Binding="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:bindings:HTTP-Redirect" Location="https://redwood.example/saml/slo"/>
  </SPSSODescriptor>
</EntityDescriptor>
```
Carlos (SE): SCIM: we support v2, full bulk import (POST /scim/v2/Bulk) and incremental (delta) with filter support. Group-to-role mapping can be scoped per domain. Example bulk payload we can demo in the POC.
Carlos (SE): Example curl to check group sync after a run: `curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer <token>\" https://api.redwood.example/scim/v2/Groups?filter=displayName eq \"blueharbor-admins\"`
Nisha (AE): They want hierarchical RBAC: enterprise-admin, brand-admin (per domain), product-admin (subset). Can we support nested group mappings or role inheritance for the POC?
Carlos (SE): Yes — we can map SCIM groups to role objects and model inheritance in Redwood's RBAC config. I'll prepare a sample YAML mapping to show nested scopes.
Carlos (SE): Sample mapping (short):
```
- scim_group: blueharbor-admins
  role: enterprise-admin
- scim_group: brandA-admins
  role: brand-admin
  domain_scope: brandA.example.com
```
Ruth (Pricing): Requesting usage profile: initial bulk import ~50k users, daily deltas ~200-300. Traffic: light token volume but needs Dedicated reservation for predictable throughput during canary. Ballpark reserved + POC support = $12k/mo; Private/VPC uplift + EU residency = +$6k/mo. Final quote after contract.
Ibrahim (Infra): Ops notes: for Private EU deployment we'll need customer's VPC peering details or co-located appliance. Also need cert SANs for all brand domains and CIDR ranges for IP allowlist.
Legal-Jen: They'll require a DPIA and data processing addendum for EU residency. Also ask the customer to confirm retention needs for audit logs (they asked 3 years).
Nisha (AE): Customer also wants proof of key management: HSM-backed KMS and export controls. Can we confirm HSM integration on Private?
Carlos (SE): Private supports customer-managed KMS (HSM) integrations and we can show key policies in the POC runbook.
sec-bot: Security checklist created: https://redwood.in/sec/q/1995001111 - items: RelayState encryption options, SAML metadata exchange, SCIM Bulk endpoint scope, delta token lifecycle, KMS integration, audit retention policy (3y), pen test summary. :lock:
Nisha (AE): Proposed timeline: Kickoff Thursday, 10 business days POC (bulk import + delta sync + SSO test across 2 brand domains), mid-POC canary with 5% real traffic, final wrap + security sign-off.
Ruth (Pricing): I'll attach a line-item POC quote and options for reserved vs burst capacity.
Ibrahim (Infra): I'll draft the runbook for network allowlist and cert provisioning. Need customer's infra contact.
Nisha (AE): Great. Action items: Carlos to send SAML/SCIM payload examples by EOD; Ruth to send preliminary quote; Ibrahim to request infra contact; Legal-Jen to prepare DPIA checklist. Follow-up meeting Monday. :calendar:
thread_text_preview: BlueHarbor POC: encrypted RelayState, SCIM bulk+delta, hierarchical RBAC, domain-scoped roles, EU residency/DPIA, HSM KMS support, reserved + private pricing, POC timeline
